# V1.9.23

Section: Source

**V1.9.23** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on January 5th, 2024

## V1.9.23

- Feature - [#4053](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4053) New Rope Pulley Block
- Feature - [#21412](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21412) New/updated preset vehicles
- Feature - Decorated sawyer bases with seasonal meshes
- Fix - [#19513](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/19513) Train wheels slower in reverse
- Fix - [#21611](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21611) Hide player option in camera mode not working
- Fix - [#21484](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21484) Fixed and optimized lights in hangar offices and hangars
- Fix - [#21477](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21477) Electric valves not working if below 90% charge
- Fix - [#21442](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21442) MC editor logic gates descriptions not showing in hotbar
- Fix - [#21342](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21342) Removed mega_island_16_3 floating trees
